description: Report an error in SalesBook: a wrong fact, an outdated claim, a missing deal or a company that should not be listed. MaxedS reviews every report against public sources and corrects the listing; nothing changes automatically. Include a source URL whenever you can.

company.description: Company the report is about (name or website)

contact_email.description: Optional: an email if you want to hear back

correct_value.description: What it should say, if you know

issue.description: What is wrong, in a sentence or two

source_url.description: Public link that shows the correct information

name: report_correction
title: Report something wrong in SalesBook
